final_message:
I added two tests to `tests/test_api.py`. The one for the new behaviour fails, for the right reason. I haven't committed anything.

- **`test_using_the_last_of_an_item_takes_it_off_the_list`:** this is the failing test. It adds bread (qty 1) and rice (qty 2), then uses the one loaf of bread. `GET /items` should then return only rice. Today it returns `['bread', 'rice']`, because the store keeps items at qty 0.
- **`test_an_item_with_some_left_still_shows`:** this passes today. It uses 5 of 6 eggs and expects eggs to still be listed with qty 1. It guards the "items with some left still show" requirement once someone builds the feature.

The full suite ran 13 tests: 12 pass and the new bread test is the one failure.

I left the expiring list alone, as the slice says. I also didn't test whether `/items/<name>/use` still works on an item that has already hit zero. The scenario doesn't say what should happen there.
